attributes.name: Strength
attributes.description: +2 maximum health and +2 maximum stamina per point above 3.

attributes.name: Agility
attributes.description: +0.5% movement speed and +1% bow and rapier damage per point above 3.

attributes.name: Greatsword
attributes.description: +1% greatsword and spear damage per point above 3.

skills.name: Iron Body
skills.description: Per rank: 2% less incoming damage. Total progression damage reduction is capped at 50%.

skills.name: Deep Reserve
skills.description: Per rank: +5 maximum stamina. Learning this perk preserves your current stamina.

skills.name: Honed Arms
skills.description: Per rank: 5% less stamina for greatsword, spear and rapier attacks.

skills.name: Lightstep
skills.description: Per rank: 10% less stamina for quick and charged dashes.

skills.name: Stonewall
skills.description: Per rank: 4% less incoming damage, added to Iron Body. Total progression reduction is capped at 50%.

skills.name: Long March
skills.description: Per rank: 5% less walking-sprint and drawn-sprint stamina drain.

skills.name: Iron Resolve
skills.description: +15 maximum health. Learning this perk preserves your current health.

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.description: +15 maximum stamina. Learning this perk preserves your current stamina.

skills.name: Swiftfoot
skills.description: Per rank: +2% walking and sprinting speed. Total progression movement bonus is capped at 25%.

skills.name: Dash
skills.description: Hold T to charge distance, release to dash. Queue an uppercut with left click while holding T.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.description: Ctrl or tap Shift to roll. Hold Shift to sprint. You remain vulnerable throughout the roll.

skills.name: Finesse
skills.description: Per rank: +3% bow and rapier damage.

skills.name: Streaming Dash
skills.description: Per rank: +15% quick and charged dash distance.

skills.name: Measured Draw
skills.description: Per rank: 5% less stamina to fire a bow.

skills.name: Roly-Poly
skills.description: Per rank: +10% roll distance at the same duration. No damage immunity.

skills.name: Point Control
skills.description: Per rank: 5% less stamina for rapier attacks.

skills.name: Deadeye
skills.description: +10% bow and rapier damage.

skills.name: Martial Training
skills.description: Per rank: +3% greatsword and spear damage.

skills.name: Charged Thrust
skills.description: Greatsword heavy style: hold up to five seconds for +15% damage per charged second. Full charge deals 175% base damage. Equip as heavy attack.

skills.name: Fast Thrust
skills.description: Charged Thrust reaches its full five-second power in 2.5 real seconds.

skills.name: Breaker
skills.description: Greatsword hits build stagger: +25% / +31.25% / +37.5% buildup. Breaking interrupts an enemy and exposes it to +20% sword damage for 1.8 seconds.

skills.name: Basher
skills.description: Per rank: +4% greatsword and spear damage.

skills.name: Devastating Blade
skills.description: +15% greatsword damage. Does not increase spear, rapier or bow damage.
